official_definition: Flash - Armed Intervention: Cost X (Reductions) (Opposing Attack Step) You can summon this card from your Hand as a Cost X (Reductions).

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Armed Intervention] or [Armed Intervention: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Armed Intervention]", "give [Armed Intervention]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
